html:
G'oya

Bronza vaqti bu takrorsiz vaqtlar ichida uchinchisi. Uni DISTINCT, ORDER BY va LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2 bilan olamiz va skalyar subquery'ga o'raymiz: uchinchi vaqt bo'lmasa, bo'sh natija NULL ga aylanadi. Bronza oluvchilar soni shu vaqt bo'yicha alohida sanaladi.

Yechim

SELECT b.sec AS bronze_sec,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runners WHERE finish_sec = b.sec) AS bronze_count
FROM (
  SELECT (
    SELECT DISTINCT finish_sec
    FROM runners
    WHERE finish_sec IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY finish_sec
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
  ) AS sec
) b

Hosila jadval b doim bitta qatordan iborat, chunki uning ichida FROM siz SELECT. Bronza bo'lmasa b.sec NULL, finish_sec = NULL esa hech bir qatorda rost emas va COUNT(*) 0 beradi. Ikkala talab ham shu bilan bajariladi.

Tuzoqlar

WHERE finish_sec IS NOT NULL ni tashlab ketish. PostgreSQL o'sish tartibida NULL ni oxiriga qo'yadi va natija to'g'ri chiqadi. SQLite esa NULL ni eng boshiga qo'yadi: namunada tartib NULL, 1810, 1835, 1902 bo'ladi va bronza 1835 chiqib qoladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT b.sec AS bronze_sec,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runners WHERE finish_sec = b.sec) AS bronze_count
FROM (
  SELECT (
    SELECT DISTINCT finish_sec FROM runners
    ORDER BY finish_sec LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
  ) AS sec
) b

Sonni GROUP BY finish_sec bilan hisoblash ham xato: bronza bo'lmasa, natijada birorta qator qolmaydi. DISTINCT siz esa namunada uchinchi qator yana 1835 (Aziz va Dilnoza oltinni bo'lishgan).

Boshqa yo'l

GROUP BY siz agregat doim bitta qator qaytaradi, shuning uchun sonni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sanasa ham bo'ladi:

SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT finish_sec FROM runners
        WHERE finish_sec IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY finish_sec LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) AS bronze_sec,
       COUNT(*) AS bronze_count
FROM runners
WHERE finish_sec = (SELECT DISTINCT finish_sec FROM runners
                    WHERE finish_sec IS NOT NULL
                    ORDER BY finish_sec LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2)

Bu yerda subquery ikki marta yoziladi. Birinchi yechimdagi hosila jadval shu takrordan qutqaradi.
